description: Reads any public GMM page as clean markdown, the same text the site serves at the page address with .md appended. Use it to follow a link from another result: /news/<slug>, /partner/<slug>, /briefs/<YYYY-MM-DD>, /entities (index) and /entities/<slug> (a researched dossier), /documents and /documents/<slug>, /projects and /projects/<slug>, /sections/<slug>, /topics/<slug>, /news and the home page /. Every page ends with its canonical URL. Paths outside that set are refused with a message.

path.description: A site path starting with /, e.g. /entities/eagle-hills. A /dv prefix selects Dhivehi.

name: get_page_markdown
title: Read any public page as markdown
